items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: We used to have a producer named Mr. Johnson... he would give me his pocketbook and I'd take a $5 bill out for everybody in the band

ctx.x: Used to be a lot of gambling around Boston. This is outside of Boston, though.

Yeah, this is outside of Boston. Now, Ferncroft is where they had a big gambling joint. Ferncroft is where they gambled, the guy used to come down after they'd win a whole lot, they'd come down to Sontag Lake Inn. A man would tell me, very bad tonight. We used to have a producer named Mr. Johnson, white head man, he was a producer here in New York and he used to come down there and he would have a companion with him, see, and when he come in, he'd come up to the piano and he would give me his pocketbook and I'd…

a $5 bill out for everybody in the band, see, so if he stayed there over an hour or longer, then I'd go up to him, the girl would say you just and I said I'm running this end of the town, now, when you get him over there you run it.
